desc: Implement a sliding window median calculator using two heaps with lazy removal to compute `cost[i]` for each valid start index `i`.
Initialize a DP array of size (k+1) with infinity, setting dp[0] = 0.

Iterate through each possible number of subarrays j from 1 to k, and for each j, iterate through all valid start positions i for the j-th subarray, updating dp[j] using min(dp[j], dp[j-1] + cost[i]) where dp[j-1] is taken from indices <= i-1.
To efficiently get the minimum dp[j-1] for indices <= i-1, maintain a running minimum as we iterate through start positions.
Return dp[k] as the result, ensuring it is not infinity.
